title: A goal holds different feelings after failure
meaning: Action after an assumption fails for an aim is emotionally expressed through combining different responses without requiring immediate harmony.
text: The Tower in the physical position of this Energy Field describes shared actions when exposed instability sharply disrupts an earlier arrangement. You may dismantle a failed foundation or stop relying on an unconfirmed assumption. The Chariot in energy gives a motive to preserve direction and advance towards a chosen aim. Temperance in emotions adds the experience of differences gradually coming together. Practice may change sharply while emotional coexistence develops more slowly: one person is interested in continuing while the other remains frustrated. A common aim makes no responses identical and does not justify the original disruption by itself.

For example, unconfirmed access to a venue makes you abandon a prepared route for a gathering. Wanting to complete the shared idea supports another option. One person is encouraged by a new possibility while the other is tired of revisions, but gradually the feelings stop excluding participation beside each other. **We move towards an aim while our different responses still find a common place.** Relief concerns emotional combination; it does not prove that the new form suits both people in every detail.

A difficulty arises if the aim requires constant acceptance of a midpoint. Tiredness is smoothed over, and another burden seems necessary to preserve calm. Temperance requires no endless compromise, and the Chariot prescribes no uniquely correct pace. The Tower promises no beneficial renewal and identifies no culprit. Actual revision can retain room for different feelings while both people clarify consequences and their capacities under new conditions.
